svg.title: Non-Crypto Onboarding via Privy
svg.desc: Flow from non-crypto user login through Privy auth, embedded Stellar keypair generation, JWT session, Express backend, and PostgreSQL registration.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Who is a non-crypto user in StellarID?')
sendPrompt('How does Privy Auth Provider handle OTP login?')
sendPrompt('How does Privy generate an embedded Stellar keypair?')
sendPrompt('What does the StellarID app do after receiving the JWT?')
sendPrompt('What does the Privy Client SDK return to the app?')
sendPrompt('What does the Express backend store during user registration?')
sendPrompt('What schema does PostgreSQL use to store privy_user_id?')
